hold_reason: Refund discrepancy: the handoff from Alpha Co (W2) reports refunds applied for orders 180 (13791 cents), 181 (17092 cents), and 184 (3930 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty ledger. Payouts computed from net_balance would not reflect these refunds and would overpay customers acme, birch, and possibly others. Payouts are irreversible, so the batch needs human review before any payout is recorded.
